title: Add a health probe to the OTLP exporter

steps.text: A wedged collector currently looks identical to a quiet fleet - the exporter keeps queueing and nothing says so. A probe on the export path is the smallest honest signal.
The exporter already tracks its queue depth, it just never reports it. I'll fold that plus the last-success timestamp into one probe.

steps.text: Four tests, all green - including the never-succeeded case, which was the one I most wanted pinned.
